facts.label: PingAn Qingteng HIDS source context
facts.statement: PingAn HIDS alerts in this legacy integration are produced from the Qingteng host-security monitoring context. This identifies the monitoring source only; it does not make the reported behavior benign or prove compromise.

facts.label: PingAn HIDS topic is not environment truth
facts.statement: Do not infer development, staging, or production environment from the PingAn HIDS topic name. Environment requires explicit current-alert or governed asset evidence; in particular, a topic label cannot distinguish staging from development.
facts.source_ref: operator confirmation 2026-08-13; supersedes legacy topic heuristic
